sentence: Rizzdom spoils fast. Speak it at the farket, or not at all.

wombos.definition: Charming, charismatic wisdom — something said that is both deeply insightful and naturally smooth. 'Rizz' is slang for natural charm and magnetism, especially romantic. Rizzdom is wisdom delivered with that same effortless appeal.
A farmer's market. A casual, clipped blend used in place of the full phrase when referring to the quirky, niche outdoor market experience.
wombos.example: We hit up the farket Saturday morning and came back with sourdough and weird honey.
